## Assignment 1 - Load Data from MET API and Initailize pyspark DataFrame
```{python}
from dotenv import load_dotenv
import os
import json
import requests
import pandas as pd
from pyspark.sql import SparkSession

load_dotenv(dotenv_path="/home/ubuntu/senthilsukumar-bu.github.io/.env")

api_key = os.getenv("EMPLOYABILITY_API_KEY")
base_url = os.getenv("EMPLOYABILITY_API_BASE_URL")
path_prefix = os.getenv("EMPLOYABILITY_API_PATH_PREFIX")

response = requests.get(
    f"{base_url}/{path_prefix}/jobs/",
    headers={"X-API-Key": api_key}
)

data = response.json()
records = data["results"]

spark = SparkSession.builder.appName("MET").getOrCreate()
pdf = pd.DataFrame(records).astype(str)
df = spark.createDataFrame(pdf)
df.toPandas().head(5)
```
